args.rationale:
Current usable stock for SKU-1006 at NODE-BOG-F6 is 800 units against a forecast demand of 50 units/day (1,400 units total over the 28-day horizon). Without replenishment, stock will breach safety stock (200 units) on 2026-09-29 and run out completely on 2026-10-03, causing 600 units of unmet demand across 16 days. 

Supplier SUP-A can deliver up to 2,000 units at $10.00/unit with a 7-day lead time (arriving 2026-09-24). Ordering 600 units ($6,000.00) would eliminate unmet demand, while ordering 800 units ($8,000.00) would additionally restore closing inventory to safety stock (200 units). 

However, available budget is $0.00. Because budget is a hard constraint, purchase order options are infeasible and cannot be executed without additional funds. As no feasible option can resolve the 600-unit unserved demand, this case is escalated with action 'none' requiring a human intervention to grant budget approval/allocation of at least $6,000.00 (preferably $8,000.00 to maintain safety stock).
